title: Task 1.1: Replying to Tom About Finding Part-Time Jobs in Singapore
content:
You have received an email from your friend, Tom, who lives in Singapore. You are planning to go there and want to find a part-time job. Write an email responding to Tom:

- Tell him what types of part-time jobs you are interested in applying for
- Share your plans and timeline for working part-time in Singapore
- Describe the personal qualities and skills you have that make you suitable for those jobs

body.answer: I would like to give you information on the part-time jobs I am interested in, such as a café server, a shop assistant, or an IT support helper.
body.example: Working at a coffee shop or bookstore near my campus would allow me to practice English with customers every day.
body.reason: These jobs provide knowledge and experience in customer service, help me adjust and adapt to the social environment, and bring extra income to improve my living standard.

body.example: I will prepare my CV this week, attend interviews during my first two weeks there, and begin working 15 hours a week from the following month.
body.reason: Working on evenings and weekends fits comfortably within my budget and daily routine without hurting my studies.
body.requirement: Your plans and timeline for working part-time in Singapore

body.reason: I can solve problems quickly at work and adjust well to a new environment, which makes me reliable for busy teams.

title: Task 2.2: Impacts of Workplace Stress on Employees and Companies
content:
Read the following statement:

"In today's fast-paced and competitive work environment, workplace stress has become a serious concern that affects not only the health and well-being of individual employees but also the overall performance of companies."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the effects of workplace stress on both employees and companies. Provide specific reasons and examples to support your viewpoint.

body1.example: For instance, workers who skip lunch, work overtime, and check emails late at night often get sick and spend their savings on hospital bills later.
body1.focus: Effects on employees: Poor physical and mental health
body1.frame: First of all, [debai] directly affects... / Effects (Body Chunk D)
body1.point: Heavy workplace stress harms employees' physical and mental health, causes burnout, and stops them from reaching a healthy balance between work and family time.

body2.example: For example, when tired employees cannot focus on deadlines or decide to change jobs every few months, the company loses skilled staff and spends more money hiring replacements.
body2.focus: Effects on companies: Lower productivity and high staff turnover
body2.frame: Secondly, in the long run... / Effects (Body Chunk D)
body2.point: For companies, stressed workers make more mistakes, show lower productivity, and often quit early, which hurts teamwork and business results.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, workplace stress damages both workers' health and company performance, so employers should set reasonable workloads to keep staff healthy and productive.

intro.ld2: reducing company productivity and keeping skilled staff

title: Task 1.3: Formal Email Advising a Tourist on Hotel Booking and Bali Attractions
content:
You work as a guest relations officer at a resort hotel in Bali. You have received an email from an international tourist who wants to book a room for an upcoming holiday. Write a formal email responding to the guest:

- Provide details about available room types, nightly prices, and hotel facilities
- Recommend popular attractions and enjoyable activities to experience in Bali
- Offer assistance with reservation confirmation and airport transfer if needed

body.answer: First of all, I would like to inform you that we currently have Deluxe Garden Rooms at $80 per night and Ocean View Suites at $140 per night, both including free breakfast.
body.example: These room options fit comfortably within different budgets without sacrificing quality, and every room has high-speed Wi-Fi and a private balcony.
body.frame: I. [Formal] Reply to Inquiry (First of all) + D. Provide Information
body.reason: Our resort is equipped with modern facilities such as an outdoor swimming pool, a fitness gym, and a quiet spa so guests can relieve stress and reduce fatigue.
body.requirement: Provide details about available room types, nightly prices, and hotel facilities

body.answer: Regarding sightseeing in Bali, I believe you should visit the Ubud Monkey Forest, watch the sunset at Tanah Lot Temple, and try snorkeling at Nusa Dua Beach.
body.example: For example, you can spend one morning walking through the green rice terraces in Ubud and taste authentic Balinese grilled seafood by the beach in the evening.
body.frame: I. [Formal] Reply to Inquiry (Regarding) + G. Provide Instruction / Suggestion
body.reason: These famous spots give travelers the opportunity to broaden their mind and gain a deeper understanding of local culture and tradition.
body.requirement: Recommend popular attractions and enjoyable activities to experience in Bali

body.answer: As to your next concern, I would be happy to confirm your reservation and arrange a private car for your airport transfer upon arrival.
body.example: If you would like to book, I would appreciate it if you could reply with your check-in dates, room choice, and flight number.
body.frame: I. [Formal] Reply to Inquiry (As to your next concern) + B. Request
body.reason: Having an airport pickup is fast and convenient for guests after a long flight and helps you stay on the safe side without worrying about local taxis.
body.requirement: Offer assistance with reservation confirmation and airport transfer if needed

closing.topic: your room booking and holiday in Bali

title: Task 2.3: Advantages and Disadvantages of Social Networking Sites
content:
Read the following statement:

"Social networking platforms have become an integral part of modern communication, allowing users to stay connected and share information instantly. However, many people are worried about their negative effects on mental health, privacy, and real-life relationships."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of social networking sites. Give reasons and relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

body1.example: For instance, my cousin joined an online English club on Facebook where she met like-minded people and shared daily study notes without leaving home.
body1.focus: Advantages: fast communication and information sharing
body1.frame: Firstly, [debai] is considered as a convenient way to [V]. People have more opportunities to...
body1.point: Social networking sites are fast, convenient for busy people in modern-day society to stay connected, broaden their mind, and share useful study or work information instantly.

body2.example: For example, many teenagers feel stressed and lonely comparing their lives to friends' luxury photos online, and some lose bank money after clicking strange links.
body2.focus: Disadvantages: peer pressure, privacy risks, and weaker real-life bonds
body2.frame: Secondly, [debai] has a negative impact on... People may face various unexpected problems.
body2.point: Spending too much time on Facebook or TikTok causes peer pressure and mental stress, while sharing private details online allows cyber criminals to steal personal identities and reduces real face-to-face interaction.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, using social networking sites can have both pros and cons: while people can stay connected and broaden their mind quickly, they face mental stress, privacy risks, and less face-to-face interaction; therefore, users should stay on the safe side and use social media wisely.

title: Task 1.4: Informal Email Advising a Friend on Choosing Home or Garden for Art Painting
content:
You have received an email from your friend who wants to paint and display some art pictures and is asking for your advice. Write an informal email responding to your friend:

- Advise whether it is better to paint or set up the art session at home or in the garden, and explain why
- Share your thoughts on why art and pictures are important and valuable in daily life
- Suggest a convenient time when you can join or view their finished artwork

body.answer: From my point of view, I think that setting up your painting session in the garden is much better than working indoors at home.
body.example: For example, you can put your easel under a shady tree in the morning so the bright sunlight helps you see true colors without straining your eyes.
body.frame: H. Provide Opinion + G. Provide Instruction / Suggestion (A-R-E: Peace & Privacy)
body.reason: This is because being in a green garden offers fresh air, natural daylight, and a quiet, cozy environment where you can enjoy personal privacy and feel refreshed and peaceful.
body.requirement: Advise whether it is better to paint or set up the art session at home or in the garden, and explain why

body.answer: I think that art and paintings play an essential role in making our daily life happier and more meaningful.
body.example: Even a simple handmade landscape picture on the wall can boost your mood every morning before you leave for work or school.
body.frame: H. Provide Opinion (A-R-E: Mental Health & Brain Exercise)
body.reason: Painting allows our brain to exercise creatively, helps us relieve stress and reduce fatigue, and makes any living room look warm and welcoming.
body.requirement: Share your thoughts on why art and pictures are important and valuable in daily life

body.answer: Why don't you invite me over next Sunday afternoon at 3:00 PM so I can view your finished pictures and maybe try painting a small one with you?
body.example: I can bring some fresh fruit and iced tea while we look at your artwork in the garden together.
body.reason: Sunday afternoon is ideal because we are both free from work and can enjoy face-to-face interaction over tea without rushing.
body.requirement: Suggest a convenient time when you can join or view their finished artwork

group: Đề thi thực tế HCMUE 22/11/2026 (Sáng - Ca 2)
title: Task 1.5: Formal Email as a Store Manager Replying to an Employee
content:
You are the manager of a retail store and have received an email from one of your employees asking about upcoming work shifts, workload support during peak hours, and training opportunities. Write a formal email responding to your employee:

- Respond clearly to their request regarding shift adjustments and peak-hour support
- Provide information about upcoming skill training or workplace guidance
- Encourage open communication and invite them to a brief follow-up meeting

body.answer: I appreciate your concern and willingness to address this issue. First of all, I would like to inform you that we can move your Friday morning shift to Saturday afternoon and add one extra part-time cashier during peak hours.
body.example: Starting next week, two team members will cover the checkout counter from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM so you will not have to handle rush-hour crowds alone.
body.frame: A. Reaction + I. [Formal] Reply to Inquiry (First of all)
body.reason: Balancing the shift schedule helps staff reach a healthy balance between work and personal time while solving the problem of long customer lines on weekends.
body.requirement: Respond clearly to their request regarding shift adjustments and peak-hour support

body.answer: Regarding training opportunities, please be advised that the store is holding a two-hour customer service and POS software workshop next Wednesday morning.
body.example: Our senior supervisor will guide everyone step by step on how to process fast returns and check stock levels on the tablet.
body.frame: I. [Formal] Reply to Inquiry (Regarding) + D. Provide Information
body.reason: This training helps employees make the most of new technology to improve productivity and gain practical experience in handling difficult customer requests.
body.requirement: Provide information about upcoming skill training or workplace guidance

body.answer: As to open communication, I always welcome your ideas, and I would appreciate it if you could join a brief 15-minute meeting in my office tomorrow at 2:00 PM.
body.example: Please let me know if 2:00 PM works for you, and feel free to bring any notes about your preferred shifts for next month.
body.frame: I. [Formal] Reply to Inquiry (As to your next concern) + B. Request
body.reason: Talking directly helps us build a strong sense of belonging at work and solve small problems early through face-to-face interaction.
body.requirement: Encourage open communication and invite them to a brief follow-up meeting

group: Đề thi thực tế HCMUE 22/11/2026 (Sáng - Ca 2)
title: Task 2.5: Causes and Solutions of Children Spending Excessive Time on Electronic Devices
content:
Read the following statement:

"Children today are spending an alarming number of hours using smartphones, tablets, and computers instead of playing outdoors or interacting with their families."

Write an essay to an educated reader analyzing the main causes of this trend and proposing practical solutions for parents, schools, and society.

body1.example: For instance, my neighbor's son plays games on a tablet for four hours every evening because his parents are too busy with work to play outdoors with him.
body1.focus: Main causes: lack of parental guidance and weak self-control
body1.frame: Firstly, the primary reason behind this is that [ld1]. This is because nowadays people... For instance...
body1.point: Today, many parents work all day and fail to spend enough time talking with or guiding their children, so kids lack proper guidance and self-control and spend hours on smartphones or tablets.

body2.example: For example, a local primary school banned phones in class and added daily football and music clubs, which helped students play together through face-to-face interaction.
body2.focus: Practical solutions: Giải pháp A (Penalize - Family, School, Society)
body2.frame: Secondly, to deal with these problems, we need to take several practical steps (Giải pháp A: Gia đình/Trường học + Chính phủ).
body2.point: Parents should reach a healthy balance between work and family time to set screen rules and guide kids, while schools and the government should invest more public funds into building safe playgrounds and sports clubs.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, children's overuse of electronic devices comes from busy parents and weak self-control, so parents, schools, and the government must work closely together to guide children and create healthier outdoor activities.

intro.ld1: busy parents lacking time to guide their children
